faq: How do you avoid wrong product claims?
We write only from the facts you provide, such as materials, sizes and uses. Anything uncertain is flagged in the file, not guessed. Health, safety and legal claims need your approval before use.
Which stores can import the file?
Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, Wix and others that accept CSV or spreadsheet imports. Tell us your platform and we match the format, so you can upload without re-typing.
Will the copy be unique from other stores?
We write fresh text for each product and do not reuse supplier text. If your supplier text is the only source, we use it for facts only, then rewrite it in your voice.
Can you add the copy to my store?
Yes, if you invite us as staff or a collaborator. We can update the products directly or give you the file to import. Back up your catalog before any import.

desc:
Product descriptions drafted at scale give a growing catalog titles, descriptions and bullet points that match your real product facts. Ecom Swift LLC drafts the copy, a person checks it, and you receive a file ready to import into your store.

## What does drafting product descriptions at scale mean?

Drafting product descriptions at scale means writing the copy for dozens or hundreds of items in one consistent pass. Each product gets a title, a short description and bullet points, built from the facts you supply. The result is delivered in a spreadsheet or store export format, so you can import it instead of pasting item by item.

Scale does not mean carelessness. Every item is written from your data and checked against it by a person.

## Why product copy affects what shoppers buy

A shopper cannot pick up your product, so the description does the explaining. Missing sizes, vague materials or a copied manufacturer paragraph leave questions that send people to another tab. Clear copy answers those questions on the page: what it is, who it suits, how it fits, what it is made of and how to care for it.

Product text also feeds search. Titles and descriptions that use the words people type help search engines understand the page, and duplicate text copied from a supplier makes a page look like thousands of others. Better copy improves clarity and findability, though sales still depend on price, photos, shipping and reviews.

## What strong product copy includes

- A title that names the item plainly and includes the main search words.
- A short opening line that says what the product is and who it is for.
- Bullet points for the details people compare, such as size, material and use.
- Accurate wording for variants, such as sizes and colors.
- Care, fit or usage notes where they help a buyer decide.
- A consistent tone, so the whole catalog sounds like one shop.
- Meta titles and descriptions written for search result pages.
- Collection descriptions that explain a group of products and help shoppers choose.
- Image alt text that describes each picture for screen readers and search.
- No invented features, claims or certificates.

## How we work

You send a spreadsheet or a store export with the details of each product: names, materials, sizes, specifications and anything you want mentioned. We build a short tone guide from your brand, then draft the copy with AI tools. A person reviews it against your facts, removes unsupported claims and fixes awkward phrasing.

We return the file in the same layout you sent, so the columns match and the import is simple. The Basic package covers a smaller batch with titles, descriptions and bullets. Standard handles a larger catalog, works in search words and adds a tone guide and collection descriptions. Premium covers the largest catalog, writes variant wording and meta text, includes a spot check by a person on a sample and offers two rounds of tweaks.

If your data is thin, we tell you which products need more detail before we write about them.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Provide accurate specifications for every product.
- Tell us which claims are allowed and which are not.
- Keep your product data clean before sending it.
- Review a sample batch before importing everything.
- Back up your store data before a large import.

**Avoid:**
- Sending incomplete or guessed details.
- Repeating the same sentence on every product.
- Claiming health, safety or performance results you cannot prove.
- Changing column names in the file after we deliver it.
- Importing straight into a live store without a test.

## Who this service is for

This service suits a store owner who has added hundreds of items from a supplier and only has the supplier's text. It suits a seller moving to a new platform who wants fresh copy at the same time. It also suits a small team launching a seasonal range that has to go live without weeks of writing.

## What we need from you

Send your product sheet or export, a few examples of copy you like, the words you want to avoid and your brand tone. Tell us which store platform you use so we can format the file correctly. We never ask for passwords. If you want us to upload the copy for you, you can add us as a collaborator or staff user with limited permissions.
